rules: Entity rows are exactly the 38 not_measured entities of the code-commit dry-run CAR (32 routes, 3 API controllers, 3 web API clients); every one of the 51 swept routes is in probes.

Each route receives an authenticated loopback HTTP request expecting its success status and an unauthenticated control expecting 401|403. Code-unit rows aggregate their bound routes: the 3 controllers as bound in PR321's plan; web tasks.ts and task-detail-read.ts bound to route:GET /tasks; web workspaces.ts bound to route:GET /workspaces and route:POST /workspaces.

GET /tasks/digest is called with a key of the real arcanada-assistant agent id in its real workspace id; on this base the shipped grant expired at 2026-10-27T00:00:00Z, so the probe expects 403 with code GRANT_EXPIRED (status and code both pinned).
